_note: For the two published exterior case studies. Restates their recorded scope and the exterior service; it adds no exterior guarantee or technical specification.
eyebrow: How the exterior work was carried out
title: Survey, access, repairs and finishing.
text: The exterior commissions at Inverness Terrace and St George's Square each covered the front and rear of a residential building. The case study records the scope, dates and finished surfaces for this project.

items.title: A defined exterior scope
items.text: Both records cover a full front and rear exterior. The scope includes the building's masonry or render, architectural details and windows.

items.title: Scaffolded access
items.text: The buildings were scaffolded for the exterior work. Mr Wallcover supplies and manages scaffolding as part of the exterior service; the St George's Square record includes its strike in late November 2024.

items.title: Repairs before the finish
items.text: Stucco, masonry and render repairs formed part of these commissions. The individual record identifies the cornices, cracks and other areas made good before the paint finish.

items.title: The architectural details
items.text: The scope extended beyond the flat elevation: cornices, windows and entrance details were included. Balconies and the portico appear in the Inverness Terrace record; columns, balustrade and railings at St George's Square.

items.title: The recorded paint finish
items.text: Dulux Trade finishes are recorded on both projects. The case study describes what was used on that building; it is not a universal paint specification for a different substrate or condition.

items.title: The actual programme
items.text: The dates and photographs belong to the completed commission. Inverness Terrace records return visits in October and December 2018; St George's Square records works from July to November 2024. A new project needs its own scope and programme.
